user_intent: FIX THESE 19 SPECIFIC FINDINGS. DO NOT RUN YOUR OWN SCAN. DO NOT RE-RANK. APPLY EXACTLY THESE 19 PATCHES.

instructions_to_general_improver.CRITICAL: The user has provided exactly 19 pre-validated findings. You MUST apply them. DO NOT run sub_mas-im-finder, sub_mas-im-rank, or sub_mas-im-designer. The design phase is ALREADY DONE. Skip to APPLY.

findings.title: author: invalid type: string 'MAS Marketing Team' in sub_mas-content-writer.yaml
findings.description: Recipe sub_mas-content-writer.yaml has `author: MAS Marketing Team` as a plain string. Goose schema expects `author: {name: '...', email: '...'}` as a struct. This causes: `goose run --recipe sub_mas-content-writer.yaml --explain` to fail with: `Error: author: invalid type: string 'MAS Marketing Team', expected struct Author`. The recipe cannot be invoked as a sub-recipe, which breaks any delegator that uses it. 20 recipes in recipe/sub/ have this bug; 19 remain after R40 fixed 1 indirectly. 76 recipes without an author field all work fine — author is OPTIONAL.
findings.expected_fix: Remove the `author: MAS Marketing Team` line from recipe/sub/sub_mas-content-writer.yaml. Alternatively, convert to struct format: `author: {name: 'MAS Marketing Team'}` but the simplest fix is to remove the line (76/96 recipes have no author field, all work).
findings.test: After fix: `goose run --recipe /root/.config/goose/recipes/sub/sub_mas-content-writer.yaml --explain` should succeed without `Error: author: invalid type`.
